groups.comment: The test parent supplies its own freshly compiled production module to a dedicated child fixture through argv.
groups.evidence: Alert 300 marks require(process.argv[2]) in undici-proxy-client.cjs. Its sole test caller uses execFile(process.execPath, [fixedFixture, compiled, loopbackOrigin]). compiled is the fixed name proxy-fetch.cjs inside a new repository-local mkdtemp directory, written by esbuild from the fixed production proxy-fetch.ts entrypoint. HTTP response data never selects the module. This is a deliberate test executable input, with the same authority as the parent process; the fixture is not a production request handler.

groups.comment: ProgramFiles locates the operator-installed Git OpenSSL in a test; execFile passes fixed arguments without a shell.
groups.evidence: Alerts 301 and 302 follow the test process ProgramFiles environment value through fixed Git/usr/bin or Git/mingw64/bin/openssl.exe suffixes. The test checks candidate existence and invokes the selected executable with a separate fixed argument array. Certificate output paths belong to its new temporary directory. Local and CI test operators control the executable environment; network requests and model output cannot supply this value. TLS verification remains enabled through NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, and generated test keys are removed with the temporary directory. This disposition applies only to these two test flows.
